```{r}
#| label: papers-setup
#| include: false
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(dplyr)
library(here)

db_path <- here("cv-app-test", "cv.db")
con <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), db_path)
papers <- dbReadTable(con, "papers_in_progress")
dbDisconnect(con)

classify_status <- function(status) {
  s <- tolower(trimws(status))
  if (grepl("^presented|presented at", s)) {
    list(
      label = "Presented",
      style = "background:#e8f4f8;color:#0c5460;border:2px solid #17a2b8;"
    )
  } else if (grepl("conference.*submission|conference.*present", s)) {
    list(
      label = "Conference Submission",
      style = "background:#fff3cd;color:#856404;border:2px solid #856404;"
    )
  } else if (grepl("journal submission|preparation for journal", s)) {
    list(
      label = "Near Submission",
      style = "background:#d4edda;color:#155724;border:2px solid #28a745;"
    )
  } else {
    list(
      label = "In Progress",
      style = "background:#e2e3e5;color:#383d41;border:2px solid #6c757d;"
    )
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: papers-render
#| output: asis

has_abstract <- "abstract" %in% names(papers)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(papers))) {

  title   <- papers$articleTitle[i]
  authors <- if (!is.na(papers$authors[i])) papers$authors[i] else ""
  status  <- if (!is.na(papers$status[i]))  papers$status[i]  else ""
  abstract_text <- if (has_abstract && !is.na(papers$abstract[i]) &&
                       nchar(papers$abstract[i]) > 10) {
    papers$abstract[i]
  } else {
    NULL
  }

  badge <- classify_status(status)

  cat('<div class="working-paper-card">\n')

  # Title + badge
  cat('<div class="wp-header">\n')
  cat(sprintf('<div class="wp-title">%s</div>\n', title))
  cat(sprintf(
    '<span style="display:inline-block;padding:0.3rem 0.8rem;border-radius:20px;font-size:0.82rem;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;%s">%s</span>\n',
    badge$style, badge$label
  ))
  cat('</div>\n')

  # Authors
  if (nchar(authors) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf('<div class="wp-authors">%s</div>\n', authors))
  }

  # Status detail
  if (nchar(status) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf('<div class="wp-target"><em>%s</em></div>\n', status))
  }

  # Abstract — always visible
  if (!is.null(abstract_text)) {
    cat('<div style="margin-top:1rem;">\n')
    cat('<div style="font-weight:600;font-size:0.9rem;color:#900000;margin-bottom:0.4rem;">Abstract</div>\n')
    cat(sprintf('<div class="wp-abstract-preview">%s</div>\n', abstract_text))
    cat('</div>\n')
  }

  cat('</div>\n\n')

  if (i < nrow(papers)) {
    cat('<hr style="margin:2rem 0;border-color:#e0e0e0;">\n\n')
  }
}
```
